title: Guided reading: John 15:5
subtitle: Track a relative idea and present-state language.
overview: John 15:5 uses a vivid image, repeated ἐν, and a substantive participle to describe continuing relation.
Let the present forms portray the relation in view; do not turn the grammar alone into a complete theological conclusion.

items.grc: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος, ὑμεῖς τὰ κλήματα.
items.en: I am the vine; you are the branches.

items.grc: ὁ μένων ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ οὗτος φέρει καρπὸν πολύν.
items.en: The one who remains in me, and I in him, bears much fruit.
